caption: The drawing depicts a single large pitcher or jug positioned centrally on the page, rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige background. The pitcher has a wide, rounded body, a narrow neck, a flared rim with a spout on the left side, and a large curved handle on the right. The shading suggests a metallic or reflective surface, with subtle gradients indicating light and shadow. Near the bottom left corner, there is a small line drawing of the pitcher in a simplified outline form, accompanied by dimension marks, specifically showing a width of "7 3/4". The artist's name, "Henry Clanet," is signed in faint writing below the pitcher on the right side. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Pitcher
